scope: Exploratory four-arm ablation specified after the baseline results, before any new component fits. Local only; not a preregistration or independent validation.

components.F: 4096 overlapping 6-mer frequencies, counts divided by 195 for each 200-base sequence
components.theta: Nine lagged mean squared differences of six dinucleotide properties, primary sample-SD table normalization
components.T: w * theta; w=0.1 for layer1 and 0.4 for layer2
components.Z: sum(F) + w * sum(theta), calculated per sequence; the SAME Z is used in both rescaled arms
components.rescaled_words: F / Z (structural information still enters through Z)

modes.retuned: Each representation uses the unchanged training_protocol.json grid and inner folds. Reuse and verify the saved full and ordinary-word evaluations; fit only the two missing arms.
modes.fixed: All four arms use the same saved primary C/gamma for each outer fold. Reuse full; fit the other three arms. These settings were selected inside training data but favor the primary representation; this is a tuning-sensitivity diagnostic, not an optimized competition.

evaluation: Identical benchmark records, reviewed labels, groups, five outer and three inner folds. Equal-weight outer-fold means. No scaler, weight search, threshold tuning or full-data final model. Inherit only grid, solver and selection rules from training_protocol.json, NOT its full-data model step.

paired_bootstrap.unit: whole group within outer fold, identical draws across all arms and modes
paired_bootstrap.interval: pointwise conditional 95% percentile; no retraining, protocol-selection uncertainty or multiple-comparison correction

geometry.description: Label-free descriptive Z quantiles and feature-block shares of squared Euclidean distance over deterministic sampled distinct sequence pairs, before and after rescaling. No inference of physical DNA structure or biological causation.

verification: Check reference artifact hashes; recompute all four matrices from raw sequences; match F and full to saved matrices; replay every reused held-out score; preserve all original files. Independent post-run audit of all predictions, saved models and parameter choices.
exclusions: changing groups or grids after observing results
limitations: Adaptive reuse of the same benchmark
Original feature parameters were selected using the historical benchmark
Structural features are sequence-derived property summaries, not measured 3D structures
Fixed numeric grids differ in effective regularization across feature scales
Grouped evaluation does not establish complete biological independence
